maddeler.e: بَيْضَوِيّ • (bayḍawiyy) (feminine بَيْضَوِيَّة (bayḍawiyya), masculine plural بَيْضَوِيُّون (bayḍawiyyūn), feminine plural بَيْضَوِيَّات (bayḍawiyyāt))
maddeler.t: Relative adjective (nisba) composed of بَيْضَة (bayḍa, “egg”) + ـَوـ (-aw-) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
s: Relative adjective (nisba) composed of بَيْضَة (bayḍa, “egg”) + ـَوـ (-aw-) + ـِيّ (-iyy)
